question_stem: A particle $Q$ and a particle $R$ are each composed of one quark and one antiquark.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the name of the class (group) of particles that includes $Q$ and $R$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
$Q$ has a charge of $-1e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge. $R$ has a charge of 0.

Complete Table 7.1 to show a possible second quark in each of $Q$ and $R$.
